subject: Multilevel SEM with categorical + nonnormal data

messages.author: 20a091f3d0e9ee8f
messages.subject: Multilevel SEM with categorical + nonnormal data
parts:
Dear colleagues,

after doing some research I realized that lavaan does not support multilevel with categorical variables. I supposed that the only way is to use MPlus for now...I also read Stan could make it. Any experience with Stan on this?

Thank you!!

Michael.

messages.author: b8fd92e5e3662745
messages.subject: Re: Multilevel SEM with categorical + nonnormal data
parts:
Do it in Stan. It democratized Bayesian computing considerably, all you need to care about is increasing adapt_delta and max_tree_depth until everything converges cleanly.

-- Stas Kolenikov, PhD, PStat (ASA, SSC)
